name.description:
Name of the context extension. This is the identifier used in the ActionExtension object
to access the extension value: _context.<name>

expression.description: The expression is what determines the projection used when fetching the extension value.

typeName.description: Type used to evaluate the filter to obtain the given projection.

filter.description: Filter used to get the object to evaluate.

title: This type is used to extend the ActionContext object (_context) at run time.
name: ActionContextExtension
